blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.
blocks.zh: 以错误为目标的学习为改进模型提供了可辨别的方法:找出模型的具体弱点,训练模型来弥补这些弱点,并检查这些弱点是否被固定. 我们研究如何将针对错误的学习应用到终端代理上,它通过与命令外壳的相互作用来解决自然语言中指定的长视距任务. 现有的针对出错的方法是为单回合任务所设计的,现有的对剂故障的分析被用来评价和调试剂,而不是训练. 我们提出由不当行为驱动的RL(MIRL),它首先描述了寻找可概括的不当行为的政策错误:在许多环境中重复的各类错误步骤. MiRL随后用RL来训练政策,开始在这些不当行为发生的步骤上展开,并且只有在通过测试并避免了不当行为的情况下才会奖励推出. 在Quen3.5-4B上,有8起不当行为占了52.1%的错步. 在MIRL培训后,该政策重复了所测量的43%到57%的不见前缀平均较少的不当行为。 MiRL在Bench Lite终端(51.8%对47.4%)上超越了TMax-4B,并在Bench 2.1终端(21.3%对20.6%)上与其相匹配,同时使用其推出的35%. 这些结果表明,针对错误的学习可以应用于现实的,长视距的终端任务.

blocks.en:
Error-targeted learning finds the errors a model makes and trains the model to stop making those errors ( Khan et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2024 ) .
This approach is desirable because it makes model improvement easy to understand, as each training example is tied to some named error, and after training we can check whether that error becomes less frequent.
For LLM agents, prior work has built taxonomies of agent errors ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026b ) and methods that locate the step at which an agent fails ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
These analyses are mostly used to evaluate and debug agents, not to decide what the agent trains on.
Terminal agents ( Bin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) are typically instead trained by scaling the number of training environments ( Pi et al., 2026 ; Gandhi et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Ivison et al., 2026 ) ; for example, one TMax training run samples from 14.6K environments and takes two to three days on eight H100 nodes ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) .
To our knowledge, error-targeted learning has not been applied to terminal agents.
blocks.zh:
以错误为目标的学习发现一个模型制造并训练这个模型以停止这些错误(Khan等人,2025年;Lee等人,2024年)。
这种做法是可取的,因为它使模型改进易于理解,因为每个培训实例都与一些命名错误有关,经过培训后我们可以检查该错误是否变得不那么频繁.
对LLM剂而言,先前的工作已经建立了剂误分类(Cemri等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2026年b)和确定剂故障步骤的方法(Zhang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年b).
这些分析大多用于评价和调试代理商,而不是决定代理商进行什么训练.
终端代理商 (Bin等人, 2026年;Liu等人, 2026年) 通常通过扩大培训环境数量来进行培训(Pi等人, 2026年;Gandhi等人, 2026年;Wu等人, 2026年;Ivison等人, 2026年);例如,一次TMax培训从14.6K环境中采集样本,在8个H100节点上需要2至3天的时间(Ivison等人, 2026年)。
据我们所知,针对错误的学习没有应用于终端人员。

blocks.en:
Applying error-targeted learning to terminal agents is not straightforward.
Existing error-targeted methods work on and are designed for single-turn problems: when the model answers a problem incorrectly, these methods generate similar problems for training.
A terminal agent takes dozens of steps per task, and a failed task is often caused by one or two wrong steps, such as reporting that the tests pass without running them.
This creates two difficulties.
First, many wrong steps are specific to one task, so fixing them one at a time does not help on other tasks; training should instead target generalizable misbehaviors , kinds of wrong steps that recur across many tasks.
Second, training from the start of a task spends most rollouts on steps the agent already performs correctly, and the agent may never reach the state where the misbehavior occurred.
We therefore ask: (1) how can we identify the generalizable misbehaviors of a terminal agent, and (2) how can we train the agent directly at the steps where they occur?
blocks.zh:
将针对错误的学习应用于终端代理并不是直截了当的.
现有的针对错误的方法在单回合制问题上起作用并被设计:当模型错误地回答一个问题时,这些方法会给培训带来类似的问题.
一个终端代理每个任务要采取数十步,一个失败的任务常常是一两个错误的步骤造成的,例如报告测试通过而不运行.
这造成了两个困难。
首先,许多错误的步骤是针对一项任务的,因此一次一次固定这些步骤无助于其他任务;而培训应针对一般的不当行为,这些错误的步骤在许多任务中反复出现。
第二,从任务开始就把培训大部分用于代理人已经正确执行的步骤,代理人可能永远无法到达不当行为发生地。
因此,我们问:(1)我们如何识别一个终端代理人的一般不当行为;(2)我们如何直接训练该代理人在出现时的步骤?

blocks.en:
We answer these questions by connecting two tools: step-level error analysis of agent trajectories and RL from intermediate states.
To answer the first question, we run error analysis on the policy we are about to train, which we call error profiling (Figure 1 (a)).
We roll out the policy on 2,017 environments from TMax’s environment set ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) ; an error localizer flags wrong steps, a teacher model corrects each flagged step so that the rollout can continue and reveal later errors, and an annotator model groups the wrong steps into error types.
Eight error types, such as “Makes false claims about tests” and “Fails to produce runnable commands”, cover 52.1% of all wrong steps and appear in 75.4% of the environments; we treat these as the generalizable misbehaviors to target.
To answer the second question, we introduce MiRL, a misbehavior-driven RL recipe (Figure 1 (b)).
MiRL builds on two known techniques, starting rollouts from intermediate states ( Xi et al., 2024 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) and providing reward signals beyond the binary verifier outcome ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Gunjal et al., 2026 ) , each guided by the error profiling outputs. Each group of rollouts starts at a misbehavior prefix, the part of a trajectory just before a misbehavior step, and a rollout receives reward only if it passes the tests and a behavior judge confirms that it avoids the misbehavior of that prefix.
To start from a prefix, MiRL restores the container by rerunning the prefix’s commands in a fresh container and keeps the prefix only if every command returns the recorded output.
blocks.zh:
我们通过连接两个工具来回答这些问题:代理轨迹的阶梯级错误分析以及中间状态的RL.
为了回答第一个问题,我们对即将培训的政策进行错误分析,我们称之为错误剖析(图1(a))。
我们从TMax的环境设定(Ivison等人, 2026年)中推出2,017个环境的政策;错误的本地化器标记错误的步骤,一个教师模型将每个标出的步骤校正,以便推出可以继续并揭示以后的错误,一个注释模型将错误的步骤归为错误类型。
8种错误类型,如“对测试提出虚假要求”和“未能产生可操作命令”,涵盖所有错误步骤的52.1%,出现在75.4%的环境里;我们把这些视为一般的不良行为。
为了回答第二个问题,我们介绍MIRL,一种行为不当驱动的RL配方(图1(b))。
MiRL基于两种已知的技术,从中间状态(Xi等人,2024年;Yi等人,2026年)开始推出,并提供超出二进制验证结果的奖励信号(Lightman等人,2024年;Gunjal等人,2026年),分别以误差剖析输出为导向. 每组推出开始于行为失当的前缀,在行为失当步骤之前的轨迹部分,推出只有在通过测试并且行为裁判确认可以避免该前缀的不当行为时才会得到奖励.
从前缀开始,MIRL通过在新容器中重新运行前缀的命令来恢复容器,并且只有在每个命令返回记录的输出时才保留前缀.

blocks.en:
We train Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) with MiRL using TMax’s RL recipe and evaluate on Terminal-Bench Lite ( OpenThoughts-Agent team et al., 2026 ) and Terminal-Bench 2.1 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) .
On held-out prefixes, MiRL reduces the rate of the measured misbehaviors by 43% to 57% on average, measured by two behavior judges.
MiRL also improves task performance: with the same number of training environments (189), MiRL outperforms TMax-189 (the TMax recipe trained on the same number of environments), PivotRL ( Yi et al., 2026 ) , and a form of RaR ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) enhanced with outcome rewards (RaR+), by at least 4.2 points on Terminal-Bench Lite and 2.2 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
MiRL also outperforms TMax-4B, the released checkpoint trained with the full TMax recipe, which samples from 14.6K environments, on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts.
Ablations show that starting from misbehavior prefixes and adding the behavior reward each contribute (7.9 and 6.5 points on Terminal-Bench Lite).
These results show that error-targeted learning applies to terminal agents when training targets generalizable misbehaviors directly at the steps where they occur.
blocks.zh:
我们用MirRL使用TMax的RL配方来训练Quen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026a),并在Terminal-Bench Lite(OpenThoughts-Agent team et al.,2026)和Terminal-Bench 2.1(Merrill et al., 2026)上评价.
在被搁置的前缀上,MIRL将被测量的不当行为率平均降低43%至57%,由两位行为判断者进行测量.
MiRL也改善了任务性能:在同样数量的培训环境(189)下,MirL优于TMax-189(TMax的食谱在同样数量的环境上接受了培训),PivotRL(Yi等人,2026年),以及一种RAR(Gunjal等人,2026年)增强形式,结果奖励(RAR+),在终端-Bench Lite上至少获得4.2分,在终端-Bench 2.1上获得2.2分.
MiRL还超越了TMax-4B, 释放的检查点用完整的TMax配方训练,从14.6K环境中取样,在端口-Bench Lite(51.8%对47.4%)上进行,并在端口-Bench 2.1(21.3%对20.6%)上进行匹配,同时使用其推广的35%.
贬损表明,从不当行为前缀开始,加上行为奖励,每个贡献(7.9和6.5分在终端-Bench Lite).
这些结果表明,针对错误的学习适用于终端代理人,因为培训直接针对发生错误的通常不当行为。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent terminal agents improve mainly by scaling training data.
Synthesis pipelines generate terminal environments from seed tasks and taxonomies ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Pi et al., 2026 ; Ivison et al., 2026 ) or derive them from repositories and human-validated sources ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
Some works train on tens of thousands of terminal environments or hundreds of thousands of trajectories ( Li et al., 2026b ; Pi et al., 2026 ) .
Recent works improve data efficiency: Terminal-Lego ( Yang et al., 2026 ) builds a more compact dataset around the inspect-act-verify loop, and Terminal-World ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) derives 5.7K terminal environments from agent skills.
Such a trend is also observed in other domains, e.g., RL for math reasoning can be effective with about a thousand or even a single carefully selected example ( Li et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .
These works improve data efficiency by improving the quality of tasks and trajectories, or by selecting learnable examples, whereas MiRL does so by targeting the general, recurring errors of the policy ( generalizable misbehaviors ).
blocks.zh:
最近的终端代理主要通过扩大培训数据来改进。
合成管道通过种子任务和分类产生终端环境(Gandhi等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026年a; Pi等人,2026年;Ivison等人,2026年)或从寄存物和人类验证来源获得(Wu等人,2026年;Shen等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年b).
一些工程列车在数以万计的终点环境或数十万的轨迹上进行(李等人,2026b;皮等人,2026).
近期的作品提高了数据效率:终端-Lego(Yang等人,2026年)围绕检查-act-验证环路构建了更为紧凑的数据集,终端-World(Cheng等人,2026年)从代理技能中获得了5.7K终端环境.
在其他领域也观察到这一趋势,例如,数学推理的RL可以用大约一千个甚至一个经过仔细挑选的例子来有效(Li等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年)。
这些工作通过提高任务和轨迹的质量,或选择可以学习的例子,提高数据效率,而MIRL则通过针对政策中经常出现的一般错误(一般的不当行为)来这样做。

blocks.en:
MAST ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) and AgentErrorTaxonomy ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) build taxonomies of failure modes from annotated agent traces, and Who&When ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) locate the agent and the step that cause a failure.
For terminal agents, TermiGen ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) finds that about half of the errors in a sample of trajectories are verification failures.
These studies use failure analysis to evaluate, diagnose, or debug agents.
We use it to drive data-efficient training: MiRL rolls out from the misbehavior prefixes found by error profiling and rewards a rollout only if it also avoids the misbehavior.
blocks.zh:
MAST(Cemri等人,2025年)和Agent ErrorTaxonomy(Zhu等人,2026年b)从注解剂痕迹中建立故障模式的分类,Who&When(Zhang等人,2025年)和AgenTracer(Zhang等人,2026年b)找到导致故障的制剂和步骤.
对于终端代理,TermiGen(Zhu等人,2026年a)发现一个轨迹样本中大约一半的错误是验证故障.
这些研究利用故障分析来评价,诊断或调试剂.
我们用它来推动数据效率高的培训: MiRL从错误剖析发现的不当行为前缀中滚出,只有在同时避免不当行为的情况下才会奖励推出.

blocks.en:
An outcome reward scores a whole trajectory by its final state.
This gives coarse credit assignment because correct steps in a failed trajectory are penalized, and error steps in a successful trajectory are reinforced.
To give more specific learning signals, one line of work starts rollouts from intermediate states.
R 3 ( Xi et al., 2024 ) starts RL from intermediate states of correct demonstrations and moves the start point backward as a curriculum.
PivotRL ( Yi et al., 2026 ) samples several actions at each step of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trajectories and trains only on the steps where these actions get different rewards.
An action is rewarded if it is equivalent to the action in the SFT trajectory.
Another line adds supervision beyond the task outcome: process reward models score each intermediate step ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) assigns step-level credit across rollouts that revisit the same state, and RaR ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) scores whole trajectories against task-specific rubrics.
Unlike the first line, MiRL starts rollouts from misbehavior prefixes collected by error profiling.
Compared to the second line, MiRL shapes rewards so that a rollout must avoid a specific misbehavior to be reinforced.
blocks.zh:
结果的奖励按其最终状态得分
这使信贷分配变得粗糙,因为失败轨迹中的正确步骤受到处罚,成功轨迹中的错误步骤得到加强。
为了发出更具体的学习信号,一行工作从中间州开始展开。
R 3(Xi等人,2024年)从正确演示的中间状态开始RL,并将起始点向后移动作为课程.
PivotRL(Yi等人,2026年)在监督的微调(SFT)轨迹和列车的每个步骤上,只对这些行动获得不同奖励的步骤进行抽样检查。
如果一个动作相当于SFT轨迹中的动作,则得到奖励.
另一行在任务结果之外添加了监督:过程奖励模型在每个中间步骤(Lightman等人,2024年)得分,GiGPO(Feng等人,2025年)在重新审视同一状态的推出时分配阶梯级信用,以及RAR(Gunjal等人,2026年)根据任务特定路标对全轨标分.
与第一行不同,MIRL从错误剖析收集的不当行为前缀开始展开.
与第二行相比,MIRL塑造了奖励,因此推出时必须避免特定不当行为被强化.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We aim to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents.
Our intuition is that a few general errors account for many of the agent’s error steps, so fixing these errors may improve the agent on many environments.
To identify these errors, we run error profiling, as shown in Figure 3 : we roll out the policy on a pool of environments, check and record the error steps, and group them into error types.
We call the types that recur across many environments generalizable misbehaviors.
To train the policy at the steps where these misbehaviors occur, we propose MiRL, our RL recipe, which starts rollouts from misbehavior prefixes instead of from scratch, and adds a behavior reward to the outcome reward, so a rollout gains reward only if it passes the tests and a behavior judge confirms that it avoids the misbehavior.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是对终端人员进行针对错误的学习。
我们的直觉是,一些一般错误是代理人的许多错误步骤的原因,因此修复这些错误可能会在许多环境中改善代理人.
为了识别这些错误, 我们运行错误剖析, 如图 3 所示 : 我们在一组环境上推出策略, 检查和记录错误步骤, 并将其分组为错误类型 。
我们称之为在很多环境中发生一般不当行为的类型。
为了在这些不端行为发生步骤上训练政策,我们提出MirL,我们的RL配方,它从不端行为前缀开始推出,而不是从零开始,并在结果奖励中增加行为奖励,所以推出奖励只有在通过测试,行为裁判确认可以避免不当行为.

blocks.en:
A terminal environment consists of an instruction that states a user requirement, a container in which the agent runs shell commands, and a test suite that checks the final state of the container (Figure 2 ).
An agent, a language-model policy π \pi , solves a task over multiple steps.
Before each step, it reads the prefix , which includes the instruction, its earlier steps, and their outputs.
It then takes one step: a short reasoning followed by a shell command.
The sequence of steps and their outputs forms a trajectory, which ends when the agent submits or reaches a step limit.
The test suite then checks the final state of the container, giving an outcome reward r o r_{o} of 1 if all tests pass and 0 otherwise.
blocks.zh:
一个终端环境包括一个说明用户要求的指令,一个代理运行 shell 命令的容器,以及一个检查容器最终状态的测试套件(图2 ).
代理, 语言模型策略 \\ pi , 通过多个步骤解决任务 。
在每一步之前,它会读取前缀,包括指令,其早期步骤,以及它们的输出.
然后采取一步:一个简短的推理,然后是 shell 命令.
步骤的顺序及其输出形成一个轨迹,当代理提交或达到步限时结束.
测试套房然后检查容器的最终状态,如果测试全部通过,结果奖励r o r_{o}1,否则则为0。

blocks.en: Besides the policy, error profiling calls LLMs to play three roles: an error localizer that checks whether a step is problematic given its prefix, a teacher that corrects a problematic step, and an annotator that proposes error types and labels each error step with them.
blocks.zh: 除了政策外,错误剖析调LLMS需要扮演三个角色:一个错误本地化器,根据一个步骤的前缀来检查一个步骤是否有问题,一个老师纠正一个有问题的步骤,一个注释器,建议错误类型,并用它们来标记每个错误步骤.

blocks.en:
We write the prefix of a step as h h .
We define an error step as a step that the error localizer marks as problematic given its prefix.
The annotator groups error steps with the same cause into error types and gives each type a name and a definition.
We call an error type a generalizable misbehavior , or misbehavior for short, when it recurs across many environments and is not tied to very few of them.
We call the prefix of an error step of a misbehavior a misbehavior prefix .
blocks.zh:
我们把一步的前缀写成hhh
我们定义一个错误步骤是错误本地化器因其前缀而标记成问题的一个步骤.
注释器组合错误步骤,将相同原因错误到错误类型,并给每个类型一个名称和定义.
我们称错误类型为一般的不当行为,或者说短暂的不当行为,当它在许多环境中反复出现,而不是与极少数环境联系在一起时。
我们把错误行为步骤的前缀称为错误行为前缀。

blocks.en: 3.2 Error Localization
blocks.zh: 3.2 本地化错误

blocks.en: To locate the errors of the policy, we roll it out on a pool of environments and let the teacher replace each error step with a corrected one, so that the rollout can reveal later errors.
blocks.zh: 为了定位保单的错误,我们把它推到一个环境池上,让老师将每个错误步骤替换为更正的,这样推开就可以揭示以后的错误.

blocks.en:
At each step of a rollout, error profiling goes through four stages, as in Figure 3 (a).
(1) The policy proposes its next step from the current prefix.
(2) The error localizer checks the step with its prefix, flags it only if it is likely to lead to failure, and writes a short explanation.
(3) For a flagged step, the teacher writes a correction from the same prefix, so that the rollout can continue without being pushed into incorrect states. The correction is checked in the same way as a step of the policy.
(4) The accepted step, either the policy’s own step or a correction from the teacher, is executed, and the rollout returns to (1) for the next step. If the teacher fails to give a correction that passes this check within three tries, the rollout is discarded.
During this process, each error step is recorded with its prefix and the error localizer’s explanation.
blocks.zh:
如图3(a)所示,在推出的每一步骤,误差剖析都经过四个阶段。
(1) 该政策从目前的前缀提出下一步。
(2)错误本地化器用它的前缀检查该步骤,只有在它有可能导致失败时才标出它,并写一个简短的解释.
(3)对于标注的一步,老师会从同一个前缀中写出一个更正,这样可以继续展开而不会被推向不正确的状态. 纠正与政策步骤相同。
(4) 所接受的步骤,无论是政策本身的步骤,还是教师的改正,均予执行,然后推出回(1)。 如果老师在三次尝试中未能给出一个通过这个检查的校正,则推出被丢弃.
在此过程中,每个错误步骤都会记录其前缀和错误本地化者的解释.

blocks.en: 3.3 Error Taxonomy Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 分类错误 建筑业

blocks.en:
To find the errors that recur across environments, we group the error steps into error types, as in Figure 3 (b). First, the annotator reads batches of error steps, together with the error localizer’s explanations, and proposes error types for each batch, with a name and a definition for each type. We repeat this on several batches and keep the types that recur across batches.
This gives a fixed set of error types. The annotator then labels every error step with one or more types from this set, or with none if it fits no known type.
Finally, we keep the error types that cover at least a fixed share of the error steps and treat the others as a long tail of rare types.
blocks.zh:
为了发现各种环境重复发生的错误,我们把错误步骤分为错误类型,如图3(b)所示。 首先,注释员会读取几批错误步骤,连同错误定位器的解释,并提出每批的错误类型,每个类型都有名称和定义. 我们在若干批次中重复这一点,并保留各批次重复的种类。
这给出了一组固定的错误类型. 然后,注释器将每个错误步骤标注在本集的一个或多个类型上,如果不符合已知类型,则不标注。
最后,我们保留至少覆盖一定比例错误步骤的错误类型,并将其他错误视为罕见类型的长尾.

blocks.en:
In our analysis, a few error types cover about half of the error steps and recur across many environments (§ 4.2 ), so they can be considered as generalizable misbehaviors.
Because these misbehaviors recur across environments, a small number of environments already gives many examples of each, and fixing them may also help the policy on unseen environments.
blocks.zh:
在我们的分析中,少数错误类型覆盖了大约一半的错误步骤,并且在许多环境中反复出现(§4.2),因此可以认为它们是一般的不当行为.
因为这些不端行为在环境中反复出现,少数环境已经提供了每个例子的许多例子,而纠正这些例子也可能有助于对无形环境的政策。

blocks.en: 3.4 Rollout from Misbehavior Prefixes
blocks.zh: 3.4 从不当行为前缀推出

blocks.en:
Standard RL recipes used for terminal agent training, such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) and DPPO ( Qi et al., 2026 ) , start every rollout anew, from step zero.
An important characteristic of these methods is that they are on-policy, that is, they train on rollouts generated by the policy itself.
Starting rollouts anew would mean that we could not correct a specific misbehavior in an on-policy manner unless the identical misbehavior occurred and was detected in a fresh rollout.
The highly stochastic nature of long-horizon terminal agent trajectories means that generating rollouts that display a particular misbehavior would be very compute-intensive.
To fix the misbehaviors in a more targeted and efficient manner, MiRL instead starts each group of rollouts from a pre-existing trajectory prefix where the policy exhibited a misbehavior.
The policy then continues from the prefix until the rollout ends.
We select a fixed number of misbehavior prefixes for each misbehavior to form the training data.
blocks.zh:
用于终端代理培训的标准RL配方,如GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)和DPPO(Qi等人,2026年),从0级开始每次新推出.
这些方法的一个重要特点是它们是政策性的,即政策本身产生的推广培训。
开始推出将再次意味着我们不能以政策上的方式纠正具体的不当行为,除非同样的不当行为发生并在新的推出中被发现。
长视终端代理轨迹的高度扭曲性意味着,产生显示特定不当行为的推展将是非常计算密集的.
为了以更有针对性和更高效的方式纠正不当行为,MIRL从政策显示不当行为的原有轨迹前缀开始推出每组行为。
然后政策从前缀一直延续到推出结束.
我们为每一个不当行为选择固定数量的不当行为前缀,以形成训练数据.

blocks.en:
However, a live rollout cannot start from a prefix directly.
To continue from step k k , the policy needs the container state at step k k , but the recorded data keep only the prefix and not the container, since saving a snapshot of the container at every step would require substantial storage.
We therefore need to reconstruct the state from the prefix, as in Figure 3 (c): we rerun the commands of the prefix step by step in a fresh container of its environment, and keep the prefix only if every command returns exactly the same output as in the prefix.
Many containers are flaky: the same command may produce different outputs depending on time, randomness, or network conditions.
Such prefixes cannot reach the required state, so we discard them.
The training environments are those of the remaining prefixes.
blocks.zh:
然而,直播推出不能直接从前缀开始.
为了从步骤k k 继续,政策需要分步骤k k 的容器状态,但记录的数据只保留前缀而不是容器,因为每一步保存一个容器的快照都需要大量存储.
因此,我们需要从前缀重建状态,如图3(c):在它的环境的新容器中,我们一步一步地重运行前缀的指令,并且只有在每个指令返回的输出与前缀完全相同时才保留前缀.
许多容器都是片面的:同样的命令可能会根据时间,随机性或网络条件产生不同的输出.
这种前缀不能到达所需的状态,所以我们抛弃它们.
培训环境是剩余前缀的环境.

blocks.en: 3.5 Misbehavior-Aware Reward Design
blocks.zh: 3.5 不良行为-软件奖励设计

blocks.en:
The outcome reward r o r_{o} checks only whether the tests pass, so it cannot give feedback on whether a rollout avoids the misbehavior.
We therefore introduce a behavior reward r e r_{e} .
The behavior judge reads the first m m steps that the policy takes after the prefix, together with the definition of the misbehavior of that prefix.
It gives r e = 1 r_{e}=1 if the policy avoids the misbehavior, and r e = 0 r_{e}=0 otherwise.
MiRL combines the two rewards as r = r o ∧ r e r=r_{o}\wedge r_{e} , as in Figure 3 (d), so a rollout gains reward only when the tests pass and the misbehavior is avoided.
In this way, MiRL avoids reinforcing trajectories that pass the tests but still contain the misbehavior.
blocks.zh:
结果奖励 r o r ro } 只检查测试是否通过, 因此无法反馈推出是否避免了不当行为 。
因此,我们实行行为奖励。
行为裁判员阅读了政策在前缀之后采取的第一m m步骤,以及该前缀行为不当的定义.
如果政策避免了不当行为,则给予 r e = 1 r = o = o = o = o = o = o = o = o 否则。
MiRL将两个奖励组合为r = r = r = r = r = r = r = r o o = wedge r_{e},如图3(d)所示,因此,只有在测试通过和避免不当行为时,推出才能获得奖励。
通过这种方式,MIRL避免了通过测试但仍然包含不当行为的强化轨迹.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
We run error profiling on 2,017 random terminal environments from TMax’s environment set, which do not overlap the evaluation benchmarks.
We roll out the policy on each environment with 2 rollout seeds.
We use Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) as the error localizer, because it is strong enough to judge terminal steps, with a reported 73.0% on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
We also use it as the teacher, because it belongs to the same model family as the policy, so its corrections stay close to the policy’s own distribution ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Raoof et al., 2026 ) .
We use Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) as the annotator.
We keep every error type that covers at least 1% of the error steps, which gives eight generalizable misbehaviors.
For these eight misbehaviors, we sample 80 misbehavior prefixes each, which gives 640 prefixes.
After the rerun check in Figure 3 (c), 219 prefixes remain (34%), from 189 environments.
blocks.zh:
我们从TMax的环境设置中运行2 017个随机终端环境的错误剖析,这些环境并不重复评价基准。
我们推出关于每种环境的政策,有2个推出的种子。
我们使用Quen3.8-27B (Quen Team, 2026b )作为误差本地化器,因为它足够强大,足以判断终端阶梯,在终端-奔驰2.1上报告为73.0%.
我们也把它当作教师,因为它属于与政策相同的模范家庭,所以它的校正与政策本身的分布相近(杨等人,2026年;劳夫等人,2026年).
使用克劳德·奥普斯5(英语:Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic, 2026))作为注释员.
我们保留至少覆盖1%错误步骤的每一个错误类型,这给出了8个一般的不当行为.
对于这8种行为失检者,我们分别抽样80种行为失检前缀,给出了640种前缀.
在图3(c)的重新运行检查后,保留了219个前缀(34%),来自189个环境.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-4B, the same base model as TMax-4B, as the policy model.
We follow the RL recipe of TMax and use their harness, except for a group size of 16 instead of 32 to control the compute budget, and a total of 160 training steps instead of 500.
The behavior judge is Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google, 2026 ) , which reads the m = 5 m=5 steps after the prefix.
It returns only a binary signal, so the policy receives no text from the behavior judge to imitate.
We run our experiments on 8 A100 80GB GPUs.
Appendix A gives the full settings and prompts.
blocks.zh:
我们使用与TMax-4B相同的基础模型Quen3.5-4B作为政策模型.
我们遵循TMax的RL配方,并使用它们的牵引装置,除了控制计算预算的16组而不是32组,总共160个训练步骤而不是500个.
行为裁判是双子座3.8 Flash(Google,2026),它读出前缀后的m=5m=5步.
它只返回一个二进制信号,因此政策没有从行为裁判处收到任何文字来模仿.
我们用8个A100 80GB GPU进行实验
附 录 A给出了完整的设置和提示.

blocks.en:
We compare MiRL with TMax-4B, the released checkpoint (step 200 of 500) trained with the full TMax recipe, which samples training environments from a pool of 14.6K.
Because Terminal-Bench scores are sensitive to the evaluation hardware, we report both its published scores and our evaluation of the released checkpoint.
We also train three baselines with the same configuration as MiRL, except that their 189 environments are sampled at random from the same 2,017 environments, since these baselines do not select environments by error profiling or any other method.
The first, TMax-189, replicates the TMax recipe but only on 189 environments: it starts rollouts at the beginning of each task and uses the outcome reward.
The other two are the closest prior methods to the two parts of MiRL.
PivotRL ( Yi et al., 2026 ) also trains from selected steps of a trajectory: it samples several actions at each step, keeps the steps where these actions get different rewards, and rewards each action mainly with an LLM judge.
Since each PivotRL update trains on a single step rather than on whole rollouts, matching the number of training steps is not meaningful, so we give PivotRL about the same GPU budget as TMax-189 for its full training run ( ≈ \approx 300 A100 hours).
RaR ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ) also rewards the process with an LLM: a judge scores the whole trajectory against a rubric generated for each environment.
The original RaR uses only this rubric score, so for a fairer comparison we strengthen it with the outcome reward and call it RaR+: when the judge writes the rubric for an environment, it also sets the weights of the rubric score and the outcome reward.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了MIRL与TMax-4B,即已释放的检查站(500步中的200步)用完整的TMax配方训练,该配方从14.6K的池中取样训练环境.
因为终端-奔驰的分数对评价硬件很敏感,我们既报告其公布的分数,也报告我们对已公布的检查站的评价.
我们还培训了三个配置与MIRL相同的基线,只是它们的189个环境是从同样的2 017个环境随机抽样的,因为这些基线不通过错误剖析或任何其他方法选择环境.
第一个是TMax-189,复制了TMax的食谱,但只在189个环境中:它在每个任务开始时开始推出,并使用结果奖励.
另外两种是MIRL两部分最接近的前置方法.
PivotRL(Ii et al., 2026)也从一个轨迹的选定步骤中进行训练:它在每个步骤中抽取几个动作,保留这些动作获得不同奖励的步骤,并且奖励每个动作主要由LLM法官进行.
自从每个支柱 RL对列车进行单步更新而非全程推出,匹配训练步骤的数量是没有意义的,因此我们给PivotRL提供与TMax-189相同的GPU预算,用于其全程训练运行(QQ\\\约300 A100小时).
RAR(Gunjal等人,2026年)也用LLM奖励这一过程:一名法官将整个轨迹与每个环境生成的线条进行比对.
最初的RAR只使用这个标分,所以为了更公平的比较,我们用结果奖励来强化它,并称它为RAR+:当法官为一个环境写出标分时,它也会设定标分和结果奖励的权重.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on two terminal benchmarks, Terminal-Bench Lite (TB-Lite; 100 tasks; OpenThoughts-Agent team et al., 2026 ) and Terminal-Bench 2.1 (TB-2.1; 89 tasks; Merrill et al., 2026 ), and report the mean and standard error over 3 runs, following TMax; some TB-Lite tasks give partial credit.
To select the checkpoint, we first take the five checkpoints with the highest moving average of the training reward, and then, as in TMax, keep the one with the best TB-Lite score.
blocks.zh:
我们评价两个终端基准:终端-Bench Lite(TB-Lite;100项任务;OpenThoughts-Agent Team et al.,2026年)和终端-Bench 2.1(TB-2.1;89项任务;Merrill et al.,2026年),并报告3次运行的平均值和标准误差,遵循TMax;部分TB-Lite任务给予部分功劳.
为了选择检查点,我们首先采取5个检查点的移动平均值最高的训练奖励,然后像在TMax一样,保留TB-Lite分数最好的检查点.

blocks.en: 4.2 Misbehavior Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 不当行为分析

blocks.en: Figure 4: Error steps concentrate in a few misbehaviors, followed by a long tail of environment-specific types; the top four appear across many environments.
blocks.zh: 图4:错误步骤集中在少数不当行为中,然后是环境特定类型的长尾;前四名出现在许多环境中。

blocks.en:
Error profiling on the 2,017 environments yields 12,746 error steps.
Figure 4 shows their distribution over error types.
The eight most frequent error types cover 52.1% of all error steps.
Each appears in 6.9% (140) to 46.7% (942) of the 2,017 environments, and at least one appears in 75.4% (1,521) of them.
None is specific to a particular environment, so they can be considered as generalizable misbehaviors (§ 3.1 ).
Prior work observes a similar concentration: in a sample of agent trajectories, TermiGen finds that about half of the errors are verification failures, in which the agent omits a final check ( Zhu et al., 2026a ) .
Our most frequent misbehavior, “Makes false claims about tests”, is also a kind of verification error.
blocks.zh:
2,017环境的错误剖析得出12,746个错误步骤.
图4显示它们相对于错误类型的分布。
八个最频繁的错误类型覆盖了所有错误步骤的52.1%.
在2 017个环境中,每个环境占6.9%(140)至46.7%(942),其中至少一个环境占75.4%(1 521)。
无一是特定环境所特有的,因此可被视为一般不当行为(第3.1节)。
先前的工作也观察到类似的浓度:在物剂轨迹样本中,TermiGen发现大约一半的错误是验证故障,其中物剂省略了最终检查(Zhu等人,2026a).
我们最经常的不当行为,即“对试验提出虚假指控”,也是一种核查错误。

blocks.en:
The remaining errors form a long tail of environment-specific error types.
Two examples are “Uses a greedy regex on log lines” and “Replaces udb inside udbuf” (Figure 4 ).
Such errors arise from a detail of one environment and rarely carry over to other environments.
Appendix B lists more examples and per-type statistics.
blocks.zh:
剩下的错误构成环境特定错误类型的长尾.
两个例子是“在日志线上使用贪婪的regex”和“在udbuf内替换udb”(图4)。
这种错误来自一种环境的细节,很少延续到其他环境。
附 录 B列出了更多实例和每类统计.

blocks.en: 4.3 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 主要成果

blocks.en: Figure 5: Terminal task performance: mean (%) and standard error over 3 runs. Dashed boxes are the scores reported in the TMax paper ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 图5 终端任务性能:3次运行的平均值(%)和标准误差. 折叠箱是TMax报上报道的分数(Ivison等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows the terminal task performance.
On our evaluation hardware, both the base model and TMax-4B achieve higher scores than their published ones (e.g., 47.4% vs. 42.6% for TMax-4B on TB-Lite), so we compare all recipes with our own runs.
MiRL reaches 51.8% on TB-Lite and 21.3% on TB-2.1, compared with 47.4% and 20.6% for TMax-4B on our evaluation hardware: it gains 4.4 more points on TB-Lite and matches TMax-4B on TB-2.1.
blocks.zh:
图5显示终端任务执行情况。
在我们的评价硬件上,基础模型和TMax-4B的得分都比它们公布的得分高(例如,对于TB-Lite上的TMax-4B,47.4%对42.6%),所以我们把所有的食谱都与我们自己的运行比较.
MIRL在TB-Lite上达到51.8%,在TB-2.1上达到21.3%,而在我们的评价硬件上,TMax-4B则达到47.4%和20.6%:它在TB-Lite上得到4.4分,在TB-2.1上与TMax-4B匹配.

blocks.en:
On 189 random environments, TMax-189 improves the base model by 10.6 points on TB-Lite, which is the smallest gain among the four recipes trained with a controlled number of environments.
This indicates that a small random set is not enough for the standard recipe of RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR; Lambert et al., 2025 ). PivotRL and RaR+ improve the base model more, by 14.4 and 14.8 points on TB-Lite.
MiRL outperforms the best of these baselines by 4.2 points on TB-Lite and 2.2 points on TB-2.1.
The result suggests that targeting generalizable misbehaviors is an effective way to choose where rollouts start and what the judge checks.
blocks.zh:
在189个随机环境中,TMax-189在TB-Lite上改进了基础模型10.6分,这是四个在受控制数量环境中训练的食谱中最小的收获.
这表明,一个小的随机组合不足以作为可核查奖励的RL标准配方(RLVR;Lambert等人,2025年)。 PivotRL和RAR+在TB-Lite上提高14.4和14.8分的基数模型.
MiRL在TB-Lite上的表现优于这些基线中的最佳,在TB-2.1上的表现优于4.2分.
结果表明,针对一般的不当行为是选择推出地点和法官检查内容的有效方法。

blocks.en: We further show a 16-seed evaluation for enhanced robustness (§ 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们还对加强稳健性进行了16种种子评价(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.4 拖欠款项

blocks.en: Figure 6: Ablations of MiRL. Starting from TMax-189, each bar adds one part: environment selection, prefix start, and the behavior reward r e r_{e} .
blocks.zh: 图6: MiRL的缩写,从TMax-189开始,每个栏目都增加了一个部分:环境选择,前缀开始,以及行为奖励r e r_{e}.

blocks.en:
We ablate MiRL by adding its three parts one at a time to TMax-189 (Figure 6 ).
Training on the environments where the misbehaviors occur lowers the score from 43.4% to 37.4% on TB-Lite and from 17.6% to 16.5% on TB-2.1.
We attribute this to the higher difficulty of these environments for the policy: the share of groups in which all rollouts fail, which give no learning signal, rises from 27.3% to 42.9%.
However, environment selection is not meant to help on its own.
Instead, it provides the misbehavior prefixes for the next two parts.
Starting rollouts at misbehavior prefixes adds 7.9 points on TB-Lite and 1.5 points on TB-2.1.
We attribute this gain to training on the steps where the policy misbehaves, even though no reward checks the misbehavior yet.
The behavior reward r e r_{e} adds 6.5 points on TB-Lite and 3.3 points on TB-2.1.
With r e r_{e} , the reward is stricter than the outcome reward alone: it excludes the rollouts that pass the tests but still misbehave.
For example, a policy may claim success without verification.
When its first attempt happens to be correct, the rollout passes and the misbehavior is not fatal; when the first attempt is wrong, the same unchecked submission makes the rollout fail.
The outcome reward alone still rewards the passing rollout, so the policy may learn to repeat the misbehavior.
blocks.zh:
我们通过一次将其三部分第一部分添加到TMax-189(图6)中来放弃MIRL。
关于不当行为发生环境的培训将结核病-Lite的得分从43.4%降至37.4%,结核病-2.1的得分从17.6%降至16.5%。
我们将此归因于这些政策环境的更高难度:所有推出失败的团体所占的份额没有给出学习信号,从27.3%上升到42.9%。
然而,选择环境并不是要帮助自己。
相反,它为接下来的两个部分提供了不当行为前缀.
在行为不端前缀开始推出时,TB-Lite增加了7.9分,TB-2.1增加了1.5分.
我们把这一收益归因于对政策不当的步骤的培训,尽管还没有奖赏来检查不当行为。
行为奖励 r e r_{e } 在 TB-Lite 上增加了 6.5 分, 在 TB-2.1 上增加了 3.3 分.
奖励比结果奖励更严格,
例如,一项政策可能在未经核查的情况下声称成功。
当其第一次尝试恰好是正确的时,推出的通过和不当行为并不致命;当第一次尝试是错误的时,同样的不受控制的提交使得推出失败.
仅是结果的奖励,仍然奖励流传的推广,因此政策可能学习重复不端行为.

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 分析

blocks.en: Figure 7: Misbehavior rate (%): the share of 16 samples that repeat the misbehavior on unseen prefixes. Judges: Gemini 3.8 Flash (used in training) and Qwen3.8-27B.
blocks.zh: 图7 不良行为率(%):16个样本中在看不见的前缀上重复不良行为的比例. 法官:双子座3.8 Flash(用于培训)和Qune3.8-27B。

blocks.en:
To verify that MiRL reduces the misbehaviors, we measure how often each policy repeats a misbehavior before and after training.
We measure four misbehaviors with enough prefixes left after the rerun check, each on 20 newly sampled misbehavior prefixes that are unseen in training.
For each unseen prefix, we sample the policy 16 times, and a behavior judge checks whether each sample repeats the misbehavior of that prefix.
The misbehavior rate is the percentage of samples that repeat the misbehavior.
We measure with two behavior judges: Gemini 3.8 Flash, which MiRL uses in training, and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
为了核实MIRL减少不当行为,我们衡量每项政策在培训前后重复不当行为的次数。
我们用重新运行检查后留下的足够前缀来测量四个不当行为,每个前缀都用20个新取样的不当行为前缀来测量,在训练中是看不见的.
对于每个未见的前缀,我们抽样了16次政策,一位行为法官检查每个样本是否重复了前缀的不当行为.
行为失当率是重复行为失当的样本的百分比.
双子座3.8 Flash(MIRL用于训练)和Quen3.8-27B (Quen Team, 2026b ).

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 7 , MiRL lowers three of the four misbehaviors under both judges.
For example, “Makes false claims about tests” drops from 26.7% to 8.1% under Gemini and from 29.8% to 11.7% under Qwen.
Since the rate drops under both judges, MiRL likely reduces these misbehaviors rather than only learning to satisfy its own judge.
The fourth, “Prints a binary file as text”, is rare in the base policy and stays at about 5%.
blocks.zh:
如图7所示,MIRL在两名法官领导下的4名不当行为人中,降低了3名。
例如,“对测试提出虚假索赔”从双子座的26.7%下降到8.1%,昆文的29.8%下降到11.7%。
由于这两个法官的税率下降,MIRL可能减少这些不当行为,而不是仅仅学习满足自己的法官.
第四,“将二进制文件打印为文本”,在基本政策中是罕见的,保持在5%左右。

blocks.en:
Training with the outcome reward alone does not consistently reduce misbehaviors. TMax-4B reduces “Fails to produce runnable commands” to below 1% under both judges, similar to MiRL.
However, “Makes false claims about tests” decreases only slightly (26.7% to 22.5% under Gemini and 29.8% to 28.4% under Qwen).
“Retries without fixing the cause” decreases under Gemini but increases under Qwen (29.7% to 35.2%), while “Prints a binary file as text” becomes about five times more frequent (4.1% to 21.9%).
blocks.zh:
仅凭成果奖励的培训并不能一贯减少不当行为。 TMax-4B将两个评委下的“无法产生可运行命令”降低到1%以下,类似于MIRL.
然而,“对测试提出虚假主张”只略微减少(双子座26.7%至22.5%,昆文29.8%至28.4%)。
在双子座下,“不固定原因的重复”减少,但在Quen下则增加(29.7%至35.2%),而“将二进制文件作为文本”则增加约五倍(4.1%至21.9%)。

blocks.en:
A common critique of RL is that it sharpens the output distribution of the base model rather than teaching it new capabilities ( Yue et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .

In that case, RL improves pass@1, but pass@k at large k k improves little or even falls below that of the base model.
We test this on TB-2.1 with the unbiased pass@k ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , using 16 runs per task.
Figure (a) compares the scores.
TMax-4B shows this pattern: it improves over Qwen3.5-4B at pass@1, but the base model catches up at about k = 11 k=11 and is ahead at k = 16 k=16 .
In contrast, MiRL outperforms the base model at every k k up to 16 by a large margin, and reaches 39.3% at k = 16 k=16 .
Figure (b) shows how often each task is solved over the 16 runs.
These results suggest that error-targeted RL raises the upper bound of the model more than standard RL does.
We suspect one reason is that MiRL keeps learning in a zone of proximal development.
By starting rollouts at misbehavior prefixes, MiRL only needs the policy to complete the rest of each task, and the misbehavior rate at these prefixes is mostly moderate (Figure 7 ).
Prior work shows that starting from partial solutions ( Li et al., 2026a ) and moderate task difficulty ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) improve both pass@1 and pass@k.
blocks.zh:
对RL的一个共同批评是,它使基准模型的输出分布更加明朗,而不是教它新的能力(Yue等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年)。

在这种情况下,RL改进了通过@1,但通过pass@k在大Kk上的改进很少,甚至低于基准模型。
在TB-2.1上,
图(a) 比较分数。
TMax-4B显示这个模式:它在通过@1时比Quen3.5-4B有所改进,但基型赶上了大约k=11k=11,在k=16k=16时领先.
相比之下,MIRL在每千 k 至 16 个基模上以大比分超过基模,在 k = 16 k = 16 时达到39.3%.
图(b)显示每项任务在16次运行中完成的频率。
这些结果表明,针对错误的RL比标准RL提高了模型的上限.
我们怀疑一个原因是MIRL在近乎发育区不断学习.
通过在不良行为前缀开始推出,MIRL只需要政策来完成每个任务的其余部分,这些前缀上的不良行为率大多是中等的(图7 ).
之前的研究表明,从部分解决方案(Li等人,2026a)和中度任务难度(Zhang等人,2026a)开始,可以同时改善通过@1和通过@k.

blocks.en:
We measure data efficiency by the training resources needed to reach a given performance level, including the resources spent on error profiling and other preprocessing.
We count these resources up to each recipe’s best checkpoint rather than over its full training run.
Figure 8 compares MiRL and TMax-4B up to their best checkpoints.
MiRL uses fewer terminal environments, and only 35% of the rollouts and 34% of the input tokens of TMax-4B.
Its output tokens drop further, to 28%, because each rollout starts from a prefix, so the policy does not generate the steps of the prefix again.
As a result, MiRL uses only 39% of the GPU hours of TMax-4B.
Although MiRL pays a model API fee for the LLMs in error profiling and for the behavior judge in RL training, which TMax-4B does not, its total cost is still lower, at 56% of that of TMax-4B, while it scores 4.4 points higher on TB-Lite and matches it on TB-2.1.
Compared with TMax-189, MiRL uses about as many rollouts and GPU hours (26.2K vs. 26.4K rollouts and 202.8 vs. 202.7 hours) but scores 8.4 points higher on TB-Lite.
blocks.zh:
我们用达到特定业绩水平所需的培训资源来衡量数据效率,包括用于误差分析和其他预处理的资源。
我们把这些资源数到每个菜谱的最佳检查站,而不是全部训练。
图8比较了MIRL和TMax-4B的最佳检查站。
MiRL使用较少的终端环境,只有35%的推出量和34%的输入符号的TMax-4B.
其输出符进一步下降,降至28%,因为每次推出都从前缀开始,因此政策不再产生前缀的阶梯.
因此,MIRL只使用39%的TMax-4BGPU小时.
虽然MIRL在错误剖析中为LLMs支付模型API费,在RL训练中为行为裁判支付费用,而TMax-4B没有,但其总成本仍然较低,为TMax-4B的56%,而在TB-Lite上则得分更高4.4分,在TB-2.1上与之匹配.
与TMax-189相比,MIRL使用大约同样多的推出时间和GPU小时(26.2K对26.4K推出时间和202.8对202.7小时),但在TB-Lite上得分较高8.4分.

blocks.en:
PivotRL and RaR+ use $999 and $770 in total cost, compared with $1,960 for MiRL (Figure 9 ).
One reason is that the reward of MiRL, r o ∧ r e r_{o}\wedge r_{e} , is even sparser than the outcome reward of standard RLVR, while PivotRL and RaR+ use judge scores that make their rewards denser.
As a result, 42.2% of the groups of MiRL are dead, i.e., all rollouts in the group get zero reward and give no learning signal, compared with 27.3% for TMax-189, 25.3% for PivotRL, and 0.13% for RaR+.
The denser rewards also let both baselines converge faster: RaR+ reaches its best checkpoint at step 80 of 160, compared with step 100 for MiRL, and PivotRL at step 595 of 1,168.
However, their scores stay at least 4.2 points below MiRL on TB-Lite.
Appendix C details how we compute the training resources.

PivotRL和RAR+使用999美元和770美元的总费用,而MirL则使用1 960美元(图9)。
MiRL, r o r r r r o vedge r e)的奖励比标准RLVR的结果奖励更稀少, 而PivotRL和RAR+则使用使奖励更密集的评分.
结果,42.2%的MIRL组死亡,即该组的所有推出都得到零奖赏,没有给出学习信号,而TMax-189组为27.3%,PivotRL组为25.3%,RAR+组为0.13%.
更密集的回报也让这两个基线更快地汇合:RAR+在160步第80步达到最佳检查站,而MIRL为100步,PivotRL在1,168步第595步达到最佳检查站.
然而,他们的得分在TB-Lite上至少保持低于MIRL的4.2分.

blocks.en:
To test how MiRL scales with the number of environments, we train it on different number of environments, 0.25 × \times and 0.5 × \times , where the smaller subset is part of the larger one, with the same number of training steps, group size, batch size, and reward.
For 2 × \times , we sample more misbehavior prefixes from the same error profiling and keep those that pass the rerun check, which gives 378 environments, including the original 189.
The score rises with the number of environments, from 42.0% to 52.4% on TB-Lite and from 16.1% to 22.1% on TB-2.1 (Figure 10 ).
Half of the environments are enough for MiRL to match TMax-4B on TB-Lite (48.0% vs. 47.4%).
blocks.zh:
为了测试 MiRL 如何以环境数量进行规模化测试,我们用不同的环境数量,0.25xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
对于2×\times,我们从相同的错误剖析中抽取更多的不当行为前缀,并保留那些通过重新运行的检查,这给了378个环境,包括原来的189.
得分随环境数而增加,肺结核-Lite的得分从42.0%上升到52.4%,肺结核-2.1的得分从16.1%上升到22.1%(图10)。
半数的环境足以让MIRL在TB-Lite上匹配TMax-4B(48.0%对47.4%).

(b) Mean and standard error over the 3 runs in Figure 5 and over the 16 extra seeds. (c) Distribution of the 16 seeds: whiskers show the minimum and maximum, boxes the 25th and 75th percentiles, and circles the means.

blocks.en:
Long-horizon agents get different scores across evaluation runs ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , and TB-2.1 has only 89 tasks, which adds more noise ( Miller, 2024 ) .
So the mean over 3 runs, which many terminal-agent papers report ( Ivison et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , is subject to considerable randomness.
We therefore run 16 extra seeds for each of the three recipes on TB-2.1.
As the number of seeds k k grows, the mean standard error shrinks at about the rate of 1 / k 1/\sqrt{k} , down to 0.62 at 16 seeds (Figure 11 (a)).
With 16 seeds, MiRL still has the highest mean score: 21.14%, vs. 20.22% for TMax-4B and 19.66% for RaR+ (Figure 11 (b)).
Figure 11 (c) shows the score distribution over the 16 seeds.
These results further support the ranking in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh:
Long-horison代理在全程评价中获得不同的分数(姚等人,2025年),TB-2.1只有89项任务,增加了更多的噪音(米勒,2024年).
因此,许多终极剂论文报告的3个以上的平均值(Ivison等人,2026年;Meng等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2026a年;Yang等人,2026年)受到相当大的随机性的影响。
因此,我们在TB-2.1的三种食谱中,每个都增加了16个种子。
随着种子数量kk的增长,平均标准误差以约1/k1/\sqrt{k}的速度缩小,在16个种子中降至0.62(图11(a)).
拥有16个种子,MIRL仍然拥有最高的中分:21.14%,对TMax-4B的比分为20.22%,RAR+的比分为19.66%(图11(b)).
图11(c)显示16个种子的得分分布情况。
这些结果进一步支持了图5中的排名。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents.
We (i) propose error profiling, which locates and corrects the error steps of a policy and groups them into error types to find its generalizable misbehaviors, (ii) introduce MiRL, an RL recipe that starts rollouts from misbehavior prefixes and rewards a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior, and (iii) show that MiRL reduces the targeted misbehaviors, outperforms or matches all baselines on two benchmarks, and uses fewer training resources than TMax-4B.
These results suggest that error-targeted learning can work for long-horizon terminal tasks when training targets generalizable misbehaviors where they occur.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们对终端代理者进行针对错误的学习.
我们(一)提出误差剖析,定位并纠正某一政策的错误步骤,并将其分组成错误类型,以发现其一般的不当行为;(二)引入MirL,一种RL配方,它只有在通过测试并避免不当行为的情况下才能从不当行为前缀开始推出并奖励推出;以及(三)显示MirL减少目标不当行为,优于或匹配两个基准上的所有基线,使用的培训资源比TMax-4B更少.
这些结果表明,针对错误的学习在培训对象为一般不当行为发生地时,能够为长距离终端任务发挥作用。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
First, we train and evaluate our method with only one model backbone, so it remains unclear how well the gains generalize to other model choices.
Second, due to the compute budget, we train each recipe once and report the standard error over 3 evaluation runs, which does not capture the variance across training runs.
Third, error profiling relies on external LLMs, including commercial ones, and the rerun check discards prefixes from non-deterministic environments, which may bias the training data.
Finally, for reward design, we mainly try the conjunction of the two rewards and have not explored other ways to combine them.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们只用一个模型骨干来训练和评估我们的方法,因此,我们仍不清楚所得收益在多大程度上被归纳到其他模型选择中。
第二,由于计算预算,我们培训了每个食谱一次,并报告3次评价运行的标准错误,这没有反映整个培训运行的差异。
第三,错误剖析依赖于外部的LLM,包括商业的LLM,重新运行的检查抛弃了来自非决定性环境的前缀,这可能会对培训数据产生偏差.
最后,对于奖励设计,我们主要尝试两种奖励的结合,没有探索其他的结合方式.

blocks.en: Error localizer Error profiling You are reviewing one step of an AI agent working on a command-line task. Below is EXACTLY what the agent saw, and EXACTLY what it did next. You are seeing the agent's context up to this point and nothing beyond it. You do not know whether the task eventually succeeded. Judge this one step. A step is GOOD if an experienced engineer would plausibly do it here. A step is BAD if it still works, but raises the chance of failure, and an experienced engineer would not do it. Examples of bad-but-working steps: acting on data it has not inspected; writing one large script that does everything at once instead of building up in checkable pieces; declaring work finished without verifying the actual output. A step that cannot work from this state is also bad. Do not penalise a step for being slow or for taking a different approach than you would. Only flag it if it makes failure more likely. blocks.en: RaR+: rubric writer Baseline You are an expert rubric writer. Your job is to generate a self-contained set of evaluation criteria ("rubrics") for judging how good a response is to a given task. The task is given to an AI agent working in a Linux terminal; the response is the record of the agent's work: the commands it ran and their outputs, in order. Rubrics can cover aspects of a response such as, but not limited to, the correct final result (the files, outputs, programs, services and settings the task asks for), meeting every requirement and constraint stated in the task, inspecting the environment and data before acting, checking the result after acting, handling errors and unexpected output, and not damaging things the task did not ask to change. Each item must be self-contained – non expert readers should not need to infer anything or consult external information. Begin each description with its category: "Essential Criteria: ...", "Important Criteria: ...", "Optional Criteria: ...", or "Pitfall Criteria: ...". Inputs: • task: The full task text given to the agent. • reference_solution: The task author's reference: how the environment was set up, the intended fix or answer, and how success is checked. • tests: The hidden tests that run on the final state after the agent submits. Total items: • Choose 7–20 rubric items based on the complexity of the task. Each rubric item: • title (2–4 words). • description: One sentence starting with its category prefix that explicitly states exactly what to look for. For example: – Essential Criteria: Writes the flagged entries to /home/user/alerts.txt, one per line, in the format the task specifies. – Important Criteria: Checks that the service answers on the requested port after the last configuration change. – Optional Criteria: Inspects the input file's format before writing code that parses it. – Pitfall Criteria: Deletes or overwrites files outside the directories the task names. • weight: For Essential/Important/Optional, use 1–5 (5 = most important); for Pitfall, use –1 or –2. Category guidance: • Essential: Critical results or safety checks; if missing, the response is invalid (weight 5). • Important: Key steps, completeness, or verification; strongly affects quality (weight 3–4). • Optional: Helpful practice or extra care; nice to have but not deal-breaking (weight 1–2). • Pitfall: Common mistakes or omissions specific to this task—identify things an agent often forgets or gets wrong. Each Pitfall description must begin with "Pitfall Criteria:" and describe the mistake, and use weight –1 or –2. To ensure self-contained guidance: • When the task names exact paths, formats, values or commands to provide, name them explicitly in the item (e.g., "Essential Criteria: Creates /home/user/filter.sh that reads the manifest from standard input"). • The judge sees only the agent's commands and their outputs (not its reasoning, and not the test results), so every item must be checkable from that record. • The reference solution is only one example of success. Other valid approaches must also satisfy the rubric, so no item may require the reference's exact commands, tools or code; describe the required outcome or behaviour instead (unless the task itself requires a specific tool or command). • Do not write any item about the hidden tests passing (or about the agent saying that tests pass): the tests are run separately and counted through tests_weight. Items about the agent running its own checks are fine. • No item may reward a longer response, more commands or more steps. tests_weight: Also give tests_weight, a number from 0.5 to 1.0: the share of the reward that the hidden tests carry for this task (the rubric score carries the rest). Use a higher value when the tests check everything that matters in the task, and a lower value when important parts of a good solution are not checked by the tests. Output: Provide a JSON object with exactly two keys: "tests_weight" (a number from 0.5 to 1.0) and "rubrics" (a JSON array of rubric objects). Each rubric object must contain exactly three keys—title, description, and weight. Do not copy large blocks of the task, reference_solution or tests into the text. Each description must begin with its category prefix, and no extra keys are allowed. Now, given the task, reference_solution and tests, generate the rubric as described. The reference solution is an ideal response but not necessarily exhaustive; use it only as guidance. <task> { task } </task> <reference_solution> { reference } </reference_solution> <tests> { tests } </tests>

blocks.en: definition The last run failed, and the agent runs it again without removing the cause. Cosmetic edits, a shorter timeout, or extra logging do not count as a change. Not: repeating a successful check. task You are a forensics analyst investigating a compromised Linux host. … prefix $ /app/jshon-20131105/jshon -e cert_b64 /home/user/evidence/1.json warning: nothing to read internal error: stack underflow (exit_code=1) step “Let me extract differently.” $ /app/jshon-20131105/jshon -e cert_b64 /home/user/evidence/1.json 2>&1 localizer The agent is re-running the exact same command that just failed, only adding 2>&1 which doesn't change the command's behavior or output content since both streams were already visible in the previous run.
blocks.zh: 定义 上次运行失败,代理运行再次未移除原因. 综艺编辑,缩短超时,或额外日志不计为变化. 否: 重复一次成功的检查 。 任务 你是一个法医分析师 调查一个暴露的Linux主机。 . 前缀 $/app/jshon-20131105/jshon -e cert_b64/home/user/evidence/1.json 警告:没有读取内部错误:堆栈下流(exit_code=1)步骤“让我用不同方式提取 ” 。 /app/jshon-20131105/jshon -e cert_b64/home/user/evidence/1.json 2>&1 本地化器 代理正在重运行与刚刚失败的完全相同的命令, 只添加 2\% 1 , 因为它不会改变命令的行为或输出内容, 因为这两个流在上一个运行中已经可见 。

Not: stopping a process that was identified first. task You are a systems programmer debugging a web security WAF (Web Application Firewall) service. … prefix $ for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do ... done (no output) step “Let me try a different approach - changing to port 5001 and see if Flask works, or start natively again.” $ pkill -9 redis-server; pkill -9 python3; sleep 2 localizer The agent's stated plan is to switch Flask to port 5001, yet the command kills redis-server and python3 instead of the unknown process holding port 5000, so the port conflict will persist and redis will be down unnecessarily.

blocks.en: B.1 Statistics
blocks.zh: B.1 统计

blocks.en:
Error profiling rolls out the policy twice on each of the 2,017 environments and yields 12,746 error steps.
Table 2 gives, for each misbehavior, its share of these error steps and of the environments in which it appears.
The three most frequent misbehaviors each cover more than 11% of the error steps and appear in more than a third of the environments.
Even the least frequent one, “Prints a binary file as text”, appears in 140 environments (6.9%).
A step can carry more than one label, so the eight misbehaviors together cover 52.1% of the error steps, slightly less than the sum of their shares.

一个步骤可以携带不止一个标签,因此八个行为失当者共同覆盖了52.1%的错误步骤,略低于其股份的总和.

blocks.en: Appendix C Cost Calculation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 费用计算细节

blocks.en:
We count the training resources of each recipe up to its best checkpoint rather than over its full training run, which is fairer to recipes that train longer than needed; for example, the released TMax-4B checkpoint is from step 200 of 500, as stated on its model card.
We also count the resources of all preprocessing stages, such as error profiling for MiRL, step profiling for PivotRL, and rubric writing for RaR+.
Most values are measured from our logs; below we explain the values that are not.
blocks.zh:
我们把每种食谱的培训资源数到其最佳检查站,而不是全部培训,对训练时间超过需要的食谱来说,这更公平;例如,释放的TMax-4B检查站从其500步的200步开始,正如其示范卡中所述。
我们还计算所有预处理阶段的资源,如MIRL的错误剖析,PivotRL的步态剖析,以及RAR+的标点写.
多数数值是从我们的日志中测得的;下面我们解释的是没有的数值。

blocks.en:
The TMax paper reports the training settings and curves for TMax-4B, but not the total number of rollouts, tokens, or GPU hours.
We estimate these totals from the reported settings and curves.
The number of rollouts is S ​ B ​ G / ( 1 − d ) SBG/(1-d) , where S = 200 S=200 steps, B = 8 B=8 environments per step, G = 32 G=32 rollouts per environment, and d d is the share of dead groups, which are resampled.
We derive d = 32.5 % d=32.5\% from Figure 11 in the TMax paper ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) , which counts the groups in which all rollouts fail; TMax notes that groups in which all rollouts pass are rare and does not plot them, so we count them as zero.
This gives 75.9K rollouts and S ​ B / ( 1 − d ) = 2,370 SB/(1-d)=2{,}370 environments.
We estimate its tokens and GPU hours from the tokens per step, steps per rollout, and throughput of our TMax-189 run, except for the output tokens per step, which come from Figure 6 in the TMax paper.
blocks.zh:
TMax纸上报告了TMax-4B的训练设置和曲线,但不包括推出的总数,符号,或GPU时数.
我们从报告的设置和曲线来估计这些总数。
推出次数为S B G / (1−d) SBG / (1-d),其中S = 200 S = 200 步,B = 8 B = 8 步环境每步,G = 32 G = 32 步环境每步,d 是重印的死组比例.
我们从TMax报(Ivison等人,2026年)图11中得出d=32.5%d=32.5\%,其中计算出所有推出失败的组;TMax指出,所有推出通行证的组是罕见的,不进行绘图,所以我们把它们算为零.
这使75.9K的推出和S B / (1−d) = 2,370 SB / (1-d) = 2{,}370 环境。
我们估计它的标志和GPU时数从每个步骤的标志,每个推出的步骤,以及我们的TMax-189运行的吞吐量,除了每个步骤的输出标志,它们来自TMax纸上的图6.

blocks.en:
We convert the tokens of the policy into dollars at the Tinker prices in Table 4 , taking the uncached share of the input tokens as two divided by the average number of steps per rollout, and add the model API fee.
This prices the policy as a service billed per token rather than as a rented GPU cluster, so we report the GPU hours separately and do not add them to the total cost.
blocks.zh:
我们按表4中的叮当价格将政策标志转换成美元, 将输入标志的未标记份额除以每次推出的平均步骤数,
这把保单定价为按物价计价的服务,而不是作为租用的GPU集群,所以我们分别报告GPU的时数,不把它们加在总成本上.

blocks.en: Appendix D Artifacts, Licenses, and Use of AI Assistants

blocks.en:

blocks.zh: 表5:软件和模型版本。 开关指令和TMax代理来自同一TMax承诺. vLLM 使用前缀 caching 和 qwen3_xml 工具调用 parser ; 港湾最多允许64个格式错误; pivotRL 将步骤与序列Matcher 相匹配, 阈值为 0.95; Qune3. 8- 27B 作为行为失当率的判断者使用低努力的思维.

blocks.en: We used Claude Code, a coding agent, in the terminal to help write Python and shell scripts and to format the LaTeX source.
blocks.zh: 我们在终端中使用了Claude Code,一个编码代理,帮助撰写Python和 shell脚本以及格式化LaTeX源.
